CustomField.inlineHelpText: Name:Value pairs separated by commas, e.g. StageName:"Closed Lost", Description:Auto closed. Quotes are optional; use them around a value that contains a comma. Test.isRunningTest and !Test.isRunningTest swap in text for {0} in the Where, DateTimeVar=minutes sets :DateTimeVar, and {!Settings.Field__c} tokens use Job Sequencer Settings. See Job Sequencer Help.
